raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The ROCm 10.1 MI45x image (`rocm/sgl-dev:*-rocm101-mi45x-*`) is built without MORI, so the MORI tests (`test_umbp_store.py`, `test_mori_backend_basic.py`) fail on it with `No module named 'mori'`.

MORI was turned off because it used to need `rocm_smi`, which ROCm 10.1 no longer ships (only `amd_smi`). The MORI version we pin (`f39fa765`) already switches to `amd_smi` on ROCm 10.1, so it can be turned back on.

While testing, two problems in the CI install script also showed up for this image:
- It didn't recognize the image's arch tag (`gfx1250-rocm1010`), guessed `gfx942` from the runner name, and installed the wrong Python extras (not the torch 2.12 set).
- When a PR bumps `MORI_COMMIT`, it rebuilt MORI for a GPU arch guessed from the runner name (`gfx942` unless MI35x), replacing the correct gfx1250 build in MI45x images.

## Modifications

- `.github/workflows/release-docker-amd-rocm10.yml`: build the ROCm 10.1 gfx1250 image with `ENABLE_MORI=1`, same as the ROCm 10.0 one.
- `scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_install_dependency.sh`:
  - Recognize `-rocm1010` images and install `dev_hip_rocm101` extras for them.
  - Rebuild MORI for the arch stamped in the image (`IMAGE_GFX`) instead of guessing from the runner name.

## Accuracy Tests

No change to model outputs. Tested on an MI450X (gfx1250) with ROCm 10.1, on top of `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm101-mi45x-20261026`: the Dockerfile's MORI step builds unchanged in ~3 minutes, then:

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_umbp_store.py` | 14 passed |
| `test/registered/amd/disaggregation/test_mori_backend_basic.py` | 6 passed |

files.patch:
@@ -187,7 +187,7 @@ jobs:
             --build-arg "SGL_BRANCH=${GITHUB_SHA}" \
             --build-arg BUILD_TYPE=all \
             --build-arg GPU_ARCH=gfx1250-rocm1010 \
-            --build-arg ENABLE_MORI=0 \
+            --build-arg ENABLE_MORI=1 \
             --build-arg ENABLE_NIXL=1 \
             --build-arg "SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=${PRETEND_VERSION}" \
             --build-arg UBUNTU_MIRROR=https://archive.ubuntu.com \

@@ -56,12 +56,13 @@ fi
 IMAGE_TORCH_VERSION=$(docker exec ci_sglang python3 -c 'import torch; print(torch.__version__)')
 IMAGE_HIP_VERSION=$(docker exec ci_sglang python3 -c 'import torch; print(torch.version.hip or "")')
 IMAGE_GPU_ARCH=$(docker exec ci_sglang printenv GPU_ARCH 2>/dev/null || true)
-if [[ "${IMAGE_GPU_ARCH}" =~ ^(gfx942|gfx950|gfx1250)(-rocm720|-rocm724|-rocm1000)?$ ]]; then
+if [[ "${IMAGE_GPU_ARCH}" =~ ^(gfx942|gfx950|gfx1250)(-rocm720|-rocm724|-rocm1000|-rocm1010)?$ ]]; then
     echo "[CI-IMAGE] Image GPU_ARCH=${IMAGE_GPU_ARCH}"
     case "${IMAGE_GPU_ARCH}" in
         *-rocm724) IMAGE_BASE_ARG_SUFFIX="_ROCM724"; IMAGE_STAGE_SUFFIX="-rocm724" ;;
         *-rocm720) IMAGE_BASE_ARG_SUFFIX="_ROCM720"; IMAGE_STAGE_SUFFIX="-rocm720" ;;
         *-rocm1000) IMAGE_BASE_ARG_SUFFIX="_ROCM1000"; IMAGE_STAGE_SUFFIX="-rocm1000" ;;
+        *-rocm1010) IMAGE_BASE_ARG_SUFFIX="_ROCM1010"; IMAGE_STAGE_SUFFIX="-rocm1010" ;;
         *)         IMAGE_BASE_ARG_SUFFIX=""; IMAGE_STAGE_SUFFIX="" ;;
     esac
     IMAGE_GFX="${IMAGE_GPU_ARCH%-*}"
@@ -93,6 +94,9 @@ unset IMAGE_GPU_ARCH
 # srt_hip pins compressed-tensors below the version required by torch 2.11.
 if [[ "${IMAGE_STAGE_SUFFIX}" == "-rocm724" || "${IMAGE_STAGE_SUFFIX}" == "-rocm1000" ]]; then
   EXTRAS="${EXTRAS/dev_hip/dev_hip_rocm724}"
+elif [[ "${IMAGE_STAGE_SUFFIX}" == "-rocm1010" ]]; then
+  # ROCm 10.1 ships torch 2.12.
+  EXTRAS="${EXTRAS/dev_hip/dev_hip_rocm101}"
 fi
 echo "Image torch ${IMAGE_TORCH_VERSION}, HIP ${IMAGE_HIP_VERSION}; installing python extras: [${EXTRAS}]"
 
@@ -244,11 +248,7 @@ elif docker exec ci_sglang test -d /sgl-workspace/mori; then
     exit 1
   fi
 
-  if [[ "${GPU_ARCH}" == "mi35x" ]]; then
-    MORI_GPU_ARCHS="gfx950"
-  else
-    MORI_GPU_ARCHS="gfx942"
-  fi
+  MORI_GPU_ARCHS="${IMAGE_GFX}"
 
   echo "[MORI] Reinstalling MORI ${MORI_COMMIT} (MORI_GPU_ARCHS=${MORI_GPU_ARCHS})"
   # Only the rocm724 and rocm1000 (noble) bases attempt to install
